# Set up environment

```{r, echo = FALSE, class.source = 'foldable'}
using<-function(...) {
    libs<-unlist(list(...))
    req<-unlist(lapply(libs,require,character.only=TRUE))
    need<-libs[req==FALSE]
    if(length(need)>0){ 
        install.packages(need)
        lapply(need,require,character.only=TRUE)
    }
}

# h3 from github repo
if(!require(h3)){
    remotes::install_github("crazycapivara/h3-r")
}
```

```{r, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
using("osmextract","kableExtra","ggplot2","sf","tidyverse","knitr","h3","janitor")
options(scipen = 999)
```

# Read data

```{r}
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
#install.packages("jsonlite")
library(jsonlite)

sd <- read.csv("large_data/Glasogw_TranquilCityIndex_ratings.csv")
```

# Filter variables

```{r}
names(sd)

sd %>%
  rename(TranquilCity_Index = tci_v3_mean,
         Rating = rating) %>%
  mutate(Rating = str_to_title(Rating),
         TranquilCity_Index = round(TranquilCity_Index,3)) -> sdte

write_csv(sdte, "large_data/tci-glasgow.csv")
names(sdte)

sdte %>%
  # slice(1:400) %>%
  toJSON(dataframe = "values") -> sdtejson

sdtejson

#write_json(sdtejson, "large_data/tci-glasgow.json") # adds \before " doesn't work
```
